<script async type="1d5c9fd2003951e8bacf7488-text/javascript">
  async function localizePricesPaddle() {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("https://ropro.io/api/localizePricesPaddle.php?product_ids=656270,656271");
      const data = await response.json();
      for (var product_id in data) {
        price_display = document.getElementsByClassName("price_display_" + parseInt(product_id));
        for (var i = 0; i < price_display.length; i++) {
          if (data[product_id].currency == "USD") return;
          price_display[i].innerHTML = new Intl.NumberFormat(data[product_id].country, { style: "currency", currency: data[product_id].currency }).format(data[product_id].list_price);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.log(e);
    }
  }
  localizePricesPaddle();

  function isFeaturePreviewHash(hashValue) {
    return /^#(?:Free|Standard|Pro)Feature\d+$/.test(hashValue || "");
  }

  function getOpenFeaturePreview() {
    if (!isFeaturePreviewHash(window.location.hash)) {
      return null;
    }
    return document.getElementById(window.location.hash.slice(1));
  }

  function closeFeaturePreview() {
    if (!isFeaturePreviewHash(window.location.hash)) {
      return;
    }
    var nextUrl = window.location.pathname + window.location.search;
    var previousScrollTop = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop || 0;
    window.location.hash = "";
    if (history.replaceState) {
      history.replaceState(null, document.title, nextUrl);
    }
    window.scrollTo(0, previousScrollTop);
  }

  function toggleTierFeatures(button) {
    if (!button || !button.closest) {
      return false;
    }
    var tier = button.closest(".Tier");
    if (!tier) {
      return false;
    }
    var expanded = tier.classList.toggle("FullList");
    if (!tier.hasAttribute("data-collapsed-max-height")) {
      tier.setAttribute("data-collapsed-max-height", tier.style.maxHeight || "");
    }
    tier.style.maxHeight = expanded ? "none" : tier.getAttribute("data-collapsed-max-height");
    var tierBody = tier.getElementsByClassName("TierBody")[0];
    if (tierBody) {
      if (!tierBody.hasAttribute("data-collapsed-height")) {
        tierBody.setAttribute("data-collapsed-height", tierBody.style.height || "");
      }
      tierBody.style.height = expanded ? "auto" : tierBody.getAttribute("data-collapsed-height");
    }
    var nextLabel = expanded ? "Show Fewer Features" : "Show More Features";
    var toggleButtons = tier.querySelectorAll(".tier-show-more-toggle");
    for (var i = 0; i < toggleButtons.length; i++) {
      toggleButtons[i].innerText = nextLabel;
    }
    if (expanded && typeof gtag === "function") {
      gtag("event", "more_features", {"event_callback": function() {}});
    }
    return false;
  }

  window.addEventListener("load", function() {
    if (window.location.hash.startsWith("#StandardFeature") || window.location.hash.startsWith("#ProFeature")) {
      document.getElementById(window.location.hash.split("#")[1].replace(/\W/g, '')).getElementsByClassName("FeatureIMG")[0].style.display = "block";
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener("keydown", function(event) {
    if (event.key === "Escape" && getOpenFeaturePreview() != null) {
      closeFeaturePreview();
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener("click", function(event) {
    var openPreview = getOpenFeaturePreview();
    if (openPreview == null) {
      return;
    }
    var eventTarget = event.target;
    if (!eventTarget || typeof eventTarget.closest !== "function") {
      return;
    }
    if (eventTarget.closest(".feature-info-button")) {
      return;
    }
    if (eventTarget.closest(".CloseIcon")) {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      closeFeaturePreview();
      return;
    }
    if (!openPreview.contains(eventTarget)) {
      event.preventDefault();
      event.stopPropagation();
      closeFeaturePreview();
    }
  }, true);
</script>

  let slides = document.querySelectorAll(".mySlides");
  let dots = document.querySelectorAll(".dots");

  if (slideIndex > slides.length - 1) slideIndex = 0;
  if (slideIndex < 0) slideIndex = slides.length - 1;
  
  // hide all slides
  slides.forEach((slide) => {
    slide.style.display = "none";
  });
  
  // show one slide base on index number
  slides[slideIndex].style.display = "block";
  
  dots.forEach((dot) => {
    dot.classList.remove("active");
  });
  
  dots[slideIndex].classList.add("active");
}
